review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the candidates most likely to compete with existing Mathlib concepts. I grepped Mathlib for other definitions of `const`, `mkHom`, `mkOfLe`, `mkOfSucc` and `orderIsoOfIso`, and for other functors from `SimplexCategory` to `Cat`, `PartOrd` or `NonemptyFinLinOrd`. Each hit was either a different concept (for example the simplicial-set `N.orderIsoOfIso`, or the constant maps in other categories) or a downstream user of this file (`Nerve`, `Subdivision`). `skeletalFunctor`, `toPartOrd` and `toCat` are named specialisations built by composing existing forgetful functors, and they are used elsewhere. `orderIsoOfIso` is a named API for `Iso` to `OrderIso` in this category, and I found no independent Mathlib declaration with the same meaning. `mkHom` and `const` are simplex-category constructors, not copies of other concepts. I found no avoidable competing version, so I report no findings. I did not exhaustively search every Mathlib file, so some uncertainty remains.
